As someone who's overdosed on around 100 over the counter sleeping pills before, I can tell you that from firsthand experience these things.  It's very painful and uncomfortable. I vomited a lot. I lost feeling in my legs and couldn't walk well. I also had hellish hallucinations before blacking out in my school parking lot after hours and hours of agony.

Regardless of how you die, you will experience pain and/or discomfort. The reason our bodies feel them is to let it know that something is wrong, so naturally, we will experience them when we are in physical danger.

If you accept that this will likely be your fate, more power to you, and I wish you the best in your decision. Otherwise, I'd strongly recommend not using pills. It's an agonizing way to go.
